title: What changes when mouthwash moves from sample to production
summary: A good lab sample is only the start. When a mouthwash moves into commercial production, the job changes. The formula now has to run the same way in a larger batch, work with the selected bottle and cap, and fill cleanly on the production line

extraction.key_fact: 구강청결제가 연구실 샘플 단계에서 상업 생산으로 전환될 때 대용량 배치 적용 및 용기 적합성 등 생산 공정상의 변화가 필요하다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: When a mouthwash moves into commercial production, the job changes.
